mapper.select: SELECT received.item, item.item_name, item.item_desc, received.zs, COALESCE(used.us, 0) us, received.zs - COALESCE(used.us, 0) kc, limits.balance_up, limits.balance_down FROM ( SELECT site, item, SUM(receive) zs FROM ly_workshop_inventory WHERE site = #{site} GROUP BY site, item ) received JOIN ly_item item ON item.site = received.site AND item.item_no = received.item LEFT JOIN ( SELECT site, item_no, MAX(CASE WHEN balance_up REGEXP '^[+-]?([0-9]{1,35}([.][0-9]{0,30})?|[.][0-9]{1,30})$' THEN CAST(balance_up AS DECIMAL(65, 30)) END) balance_up, MAX(CASE WHEN balance_down REGEXP '^[+-]?([0-9]{1,35}([.][0-9]{0,30})?|[.][0-9]{1,30})$' THEN CAST(balance_down AS DECIMAL(65, 30)) END) balance_down FROM ly_item_bom_relation WHERE site = #{site} GROUP BY site, item_no ) limits ON limits.site = received.site AND limits.item_no = received.item LEFT JOIN ( SELECT site, item, SUM(use_num) us FROM ly_sfc_assembly WHERE site = #{site} GROUP BY site, item ) used ON used.site = received.site AND used.item = received.item ORDER BY received.item
